statement_map.email_excerpt: You contacted us because your custom domain had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days, even though your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link.

Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record pointing to an old server address and added a CNAME record using the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings, after which your dashboard showed the domain as connected and your funnel loaded on it.

Following our guidance, you deleted the second record for the www version and added a CNAME record for www with the same target value, and you confirmed both your domain and its www version now load your funnel.
We explained that the old A record pointing to an old server address was blocking the connection.
We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting a domain.
The morning after our call, we will check that your secure certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.
